Remark
[Projective-space counterexamples] 1. ch9:3.11The real projective space $P^2(\mathbf{R})$ of dimension two, which is compact, non-orientable and not simply connected, is an example which shows the necessity of orientability in a) and odd dimension in b). On the other hand, $P^3(\mathbf{R})$ which is compact, orientable and not simply connected is an example which shows the necessity of even dimension in (a).
